title: Endurance
definition: Endurance is continuing in faith, obedience, and hope through trials, suffering, delay, opposition, and weariness.
summary: The Christian life requires perseverance. God strengthens His people to remain faithful when obedience is costly.
christFocus: Christ endured suffering and the cross, and He strengthens His people to endure with hope.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Christian life requires perseverance. God strengthens His people to remain faithful when obedience is costly.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
